note: Numbers in vanilla-extract and StyleX styles keep their library's meaning instead of Devup UI's spacing scale: vanilla-extract styles add `px` in `.css.ts` files and in `style()`, `globalStyle()` and `keyframes()` calls inside ordinary modules, StyleX adds `px`/`ms` to static values and to numbers passed to dynamic styles, and unitless properties such as `columnCount`, `strokeWidth`, `orphans` or `zoom` keep a bare number everywhere. The Next.js plugin now runs every `.css.ts` module on the full engine instead of a separate static fast path, so development and production builds produce the same output
